are here.

The Premier Series v2 is more than a next-generation release; it is the definitive performance benchmark in its class. Designed as a sophisticated gateway to near-reference quality sound, this series offers an approachable entry point into high-end audio for those seeking a significant upgrade from standard systems. We have engineered the v2 to act as the conduit between everyday home audio and the pinnacle of acoustic fidelity, delivering a clear pathway for listeners to experience music and film with a level of precision and immersion previously unattainable at this price point.
At the heart of this series is a core Paradigm philosophy:

body.text: There is no value in the absence of performance.

content: This conviction drives every engineering decision we make. It’s why we’ve integrated flagship-inspired technologies—like the AL-MAC™ high-frequency drivers and Carbon-X™ unibody bass drivers—into a series that remains within reach. By focusing on technical excellence over unnecessary complexity, the Premier v2 ensures that every design element serves a singular purpose: delivering an authentic, high-performance listening reality that honors the artist’s original intent.

content.text:
Decades of Innovation.
Engineered for Excellence.

content: For over 40 years, Paradigm has set the standard for high-performance audio through a commitment to rigorous research and world-class engineering. Our heritage is built on the belief that everyone should have access to exceptional sound. Every speaker in the Premier v2 series is designed, engineered, and overseen by our team at our headquarters in Canada, ensuring our flagship DNA is reflected in every component we create.

The Premier v2 brings the laboratory to the living room. By distilling the groundbreaking technologies of our flagship systems into a more accessible format, we’ve created a series that strips away the barriers between standard playback and true reference-grade fidelity. Choosing Paradigm means inheriting decades of award-winning engineering and a relentless passion for performance that defines its class.

title: Introducing Musical Fidelity M5xi and M6xi
excerpt: Musical Fidelity announces the launch of the M5xi & M6xi, two high-performance integrated amplifier engineered with advanced technology to deliver exceptional sound quality and modern versatility…

cover.alt: Close-up of the Musical Fidelity M6xi front panel and volume knob

content: Musical Fidelity announces the launch of the M5xi & M6xi, two high-performance integrated amplifier engineered with advanced technology to deliver exceptional sound quality and modern versatility. Building on the outstanding success of its predecessor, the M5xi is a major reinvention of the M5 formula. The M6xi is the latest evolution in its acclaimed M6 amplifier series, combining high-end engineering with modern connectivity.

Designed with technology derived from the flagship TITAN amplifier, the M5xi & M6xi feature a fully discrete dual-mono power amplifier design. Refined circuitry, low-distortion output stage, and optimized PCB layout ensure outstanding sonic performance.

They introduce enhanced connectivity options, including HDMI eARC, USB-C, optical and coaxial inputs, as well as RS232 integration for custom installations. A newly added isolated USB power output further improves performance for external streaming devices.
With an upgraded MM/MC phono stage, improved shielding, and meticulous internal design, they deliver remarkable clarity and depth for your favourite vinyl records.

title: Affordable, High-End Turntables
excerpt: While premium turntables often come with a hefty price tag, there’s a growing selection of affordable high-end turntables that deliver exceptional performance without breaking the bank. If you’re…

cover.alt: Red Pro-Ject Debut Evo 2 turntable on a glass shelf

body.text: Affordable, High-End Turntables: The Gift for the True Music Enthusiast

content: While premium turntables often come with a hefty price tag, there’s a growing selection of affordable high-end turntables that deliver exceptional performance without breaking the bank. If you’re looking to elevate your vinyl experience this season—whether you’re an experienced audiophile or a newcomer eager to step up your game—there’s no better time to invest in a turntable that combines quality and value.

The choice of turntable matters. Affordable high-end turntables from brands like Pro-Ject, Thorens are built with audiophile-grade components that focus on clarity, precision, and incredible sound reproduction. These models offer features like advanced tonearms, superior cartridges, and vibration-reducing designs that bring out the finest details in every track.

When you invest in a high-performance turntable, you’re not just purchasing a piece of equipment—you’re investing in a richer, more immersive musical experience. Whether it’s the richness of jazz, the texture of classical, or the punch of rock and roll, a premium turntable reveals subtleties in your favorite albums that you might not have even realized were there.

items: The S10's 500W RMS amplifier and high-excursion S-PAL driver produce deep, impactful bass with speed and control.
ARC ensures optimal sound in any space, and you can download the latest version for PC or Mac to use with an ARC microphone.

The S10 comes with a wireless transmitter that pairs with a built-in receiver, making setup easy. You can also use the Paradigm Subwoofer Control app for iOS and Android to control the S10. The app includes three preset listening modes for music, movies, and night, and you can also adjust the level, phase, and crossover frequency.
The S10 measures 13.82” x 13.46” x 14.88” and has a sealed, front-firing design that blends into a variety of room styles. It's available in satin white or gloss black.

title: A1 The return of a true hi-fi classic
excerpt: Musical Fidelity brings back one of the most iconic hi-fi integrated amplifiers of all time. When you think of design icons, what comes to mind are cars like the Porsche 911, the Ray-Ban Wayfarer…

cover.alt: Musical Fidelity A1 integrated Class A amplifier, its power light glowing in the dark

content: Musical Fidelity brings back one of the most iconic hi-fi integrated amplifiers of all time.

When you think of design icons, what comes to mind are cars like the Porsche 911, the Ray-Ban Wayfarer glasses or the Bialetti espresso pot. In hi-fi, the Musical Fidelity A1 has become one of the most classic designs – inside and out. First released back in the 90s, it quickly made waves for being an absolute beast when it came down to driving some of the most difficult speakers of that time, even though it was actually a rather low powered integrated amplifier. But: it was all done in pure Class A with excellent and expertly laid out discrete symmetrical circuitry topology and using only highest quality components. The A1 showed people that there was more to amplifiers than just high power. Based on its huge success, the A1 has gone through multiple reissues amd new versions over the years. Now for 2023, for the first time since its initial release we have actually kept all specifications, the appearance and circuits of the 1990’s rendition for those who missed out the first time. With an updated transformer, power supplies and modern low noise components we’ve revitalized the formula and are proud to reintroduce the fresh original – three decades later.
